_comment: Clinica Artica pilot batch (EPIC-002, SPEC-008 CA-3; ADR-003 §3-§4, ADR-005). Extends probe_config.json: providers, prices, currency and weights are inherited unchanged; this file replaces user_location and batch as a whole. Levels are read from the prompt id prefix (AV core, AR area of influence, AG Galicia) and are reported apart: the weighted SoV uses only AV. Brands take part by membership (the list below), not by city: pilot brands based in Vigo or Pontevedra stay out of the Vigo batch (ADR-005 §5). Competitor sources and dates: SPEC-008 ledger.

batch.name: piloto-artica-viveiro
batch.title: Resumen del probe — piloto Clínica Ártica (lote Viveiro)

levels.label: núcleo: Viveiro y A Mariña (único nivel del criterio Go)
área de influencia (indicador aparte, no cuenta para el Go)

batch._runs_comment: Runs per level (SPEC-008 CA-5 and CA-9 dictamen, 2026-09-29): the plain command is the official baseline of the Go criterion (AV 3 runs, smoke c = 0.1142 EUR <= 0.19; AR/AG 1 run) and --levels AV is each Go 'after' measurement (same 3 runs). Weekly tracking overrides with --levels AV --runs 1. --runs overrides every selected level.

go._comment: Go criterion with the probe (SPEC-008 CA-9 dictamen, CA-10): ceiling warning when the core weighted SoV is >= ceiling (only AV, only the probe); a Go measurement is complete when every weighted provider has >= min_valid_share of its AV rows with status=ok (relaunch with --resume in the same week otherwise).

batch._client_review_aliases_comment: Client aliases that are also a common word (F-SPEC-008-3, CA-9 (h)): answers naming the client only through them still count (RN-01 literal) and are listed in summary.md for manual review.
